Title: Corrective workspace quiescence reset
Purpose: Use when publish/delete/export or disposal can still race pending definition persistence or operate on stale local editor state.
Deliverables: A narrow corrective scope that restores the broken invariant.
Fresh proof showing the failed gate can now pass.
An updated execution report and gate memo log.
ValidationCommands: Rerun the exact failed gate proof plus any direct corrective-scope tests.
ReviewQuestions: Is the originally failed invariant now restored strongly enough for the gate to pass?
Did the corrective work stay narrow instead of widening the initiative again?
Was the failed gate rerun and recorded from live proof?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Do not resume the numbered queue until the failed gate is rerun successfully.
